BENEFITS OF MEMBER [redacted-name] GOLFERS APPLY THROUGH THE BRS GOLF MEMBERS WEBSITE AND APP APPLICATION COMPLETED IN A FEW CLICKS CLUB GETS PAID IN FULL THE NEXT DAY NO CLAW BACKS FOR NON-PAYERS PAY FOR MULTIPLE MEMBER [redacted-name] ONE GO TRACK THE WHOLE PROCESS ONLINE ABSOLUTELY NO ADMINISTRATION NEEDED BY THE CLUB SIGN UP NOW FAQs WHAT IS MEMBER [redacted-name]? BRS GOLF have teamed up V12 Retail Finance Limited (V12) to bring to you a new and flexible way for your members to pay for their golf club fees by spreading the cost across a number of payment periods to suit their budget. WHAT ARE THE BENEFITS FOR THE CLUB? BRS GOLF want to help you grow the game of golf, by increasing your member [redacted-name] and offering an alternative option to an upfront payment for golf fees. This will allow the golfer [redacted-name] the cost of their member [redacted-name] may appeal to a different sector of golfer. In addition the club will still get paid the full fees up front. NO INVOLVEMENT IN THE CREDIT APPLICATION. In working with V12 we have developed a fully-integrated solution for the finance application, meaning golfers can self-serve in applying for their member [redacted-name] through their BRS GOLF member login (desktop and/or mobile applications available). This fast, simple and secure application, makes it extremely easy for your golfers to pay for their member [redacted-name] a short on line application process - no more antiquated paper forms to hand write. Importantly, once BRS GOLF have handed the customer [redacted-name] to V12 the club members credit application is handled by V12 and the club member directly. You don't have to get involved in any sale of the finance or the legal obligations that go with it. In fact, the application for finance is so integrated we strongly believe this will increase your member [redacted-name] through this quick and popular form of payment. REDUCED RISK OF LOST FEES. Once V12 have paid you, the member [redacted-name] is between the Golfer and V12. You won't have to worry about any recourse if something goes wrong or if the golfer [redacted-name] their payment to V12. In fact, it's only in exceptional circumstances that V12 may need the clubs help to resolve member [redacted-name]. QUICK SETTLEMENT! The V12 system will provide the golfer with a quick decision within seconds of them completing their details online. Once accepted, the golfer [redacted-name] their credit agreement, the member [redacted-name] is activated immediately and you will receive payment to your bank account within 4 working days from the golfer [redacted-name] agreement. It's as quick as that. HOW DO YOU PROMOTE MEMBER [redacted-name] TO THE GOLFER? BRS GOLF will help you with advertising Member [redacted-name] to all your members (including template emails for you to send, promotional banners within your members' booking website and suggested push notifications for your app users). All financial related terms and facts will be supplied by V12. The only rule, for regulatory reasons, is that you cannot use your own credit advertisement. This benefits you in knowing that any promotion of Member [redacted-name] will be legally compliant. WHAT CAN BE INCLUDED IN THE MEMBER [redacted-name] LOAN? At the moment only the golfers playing fees can be financed this means that green fees, locker fees, buggy hire, or any other playing fees, paid for up front and spread over the term of the golfers member [redacted-name]. In the future we are working with V12 to look at adding other golfer's requirements to the member [redacted-name] so that golfers will have even more affinity with the club. WHAT DOES IT COST? The Golfer [redacted-name] charged a small administration fee on top of their loan. For this product the club won't be charged any subsidy and you will receive the full member [redacted-name]. Member [redacted-name] can be offered on 4 or 10 month terms meaning there are extremely flexible options for you to offer Member [redacted-name] to full year or partial year memberships. HOW DO WE KNOW IF A MEMBER [redacted-name] FINANCE? Through your access to the V12 system, you will have a number of helpful tools to identify which member [redacted-name] successful in their loan application, the loan amount and when this was sent to your bank account. You will also be able to run simple reports which you can download for use in your own accounting system. DO WE HAVE TO BE AUTHORISED BY THE FINANCIAL CONDUCT AUTHORITY (FCA) If you are not authorised in your own right, you can offer the interest free finance loans only, however, the agreement with V12 is that they will consider appointing the club as an Introducer Appointed Representative (IAR). As an IAR you will need to comply with V12’s specific instructions and standards for how member [redacted-name] is promoted to your members. HOW LONG DOES IT TAKE TO SIGN-UP? You will be required to provide some information to V12 directly via an online form. V12 will need to approve your application and you should be ready to go within 10 working days of V12 receiving correctly completed documentation. Once approved you will be contacted by BRS Golf and V12 with your Member [redacted-name] access rights V12 Retail Finance Limited is registered in England and Wales [redacted-number]. SIGN UP FIND OUT MORE Email [redacted-email] for enquiries IN PARTNERSHIP WITH INTRODUCING OUR FINANCE PARTNER Retail finance gives customers the flexibility to buy what they really want with the option to spread the cost of their purchase of over a repayment period that suits their budget. V12 Retail Finance understand how retail finance can unlock your sales potential, and their innovative, customer [redacted-name] integrates seamlessly and will help transform your business. Working with V12 will give your customers the flexibility to choose the member [redacted-name] want with the option to spread the cost using a range of simple and straightforward finance options. BENEFITS OF MEMBER [redacted-name] GOLFERS APPLY THROUGH THE BRS GOLF MEMBERS WEBSITE AND APP APPLICATION COMPLETED IN A FEW CLICKS CLUB GETS PAID IN FULL THE NEXT DAY NO CLAW BACKS FOR NON-PAYERS PAY FOR MULTIPLE MEMBER [redacted-name] ONE GO TRACK THE WHOLE PROCESS ONLINE ABSOLUTELY NO ADMINISTRATION NEEDED BY THE CLUB SIGN UP NOW FAQs WHAT IS MEMBER [redacted-name]? BRS GOLF have teamed up V12 Retail Finance Limited (V12) to bring to you a new and flexible way for your members to pay for their golf club fees by spreading the cost across a number of payment periods to suit their budget. WHAT ARE THE BENEFITS FOR THE CLUB? BRS GOLF want to help you grow the game of golf, by increasing your member [redacted-name] and offering an alternative option to an upfront payment for golf fees. This will allow the golfer [redacted-name] the cost of their member [redacted-name] may appeal to a different sector of golfer. In addition the club will still get paid the full fees up front. NO INVOLVEMENT IN THE CREDIT APPLICATION. In working with V12 we have developed a fully-integrated solution for the finance application, meaning golfers can self-serve in applying for their member [redacted-name] through their BRS GOLF member login (desktop and/or mobile applications available). This fast, simple and secure application, makes it extremely easy for your golfers to pay for their member [redacted-name] a short on line application process - no more antiquated paper forms to hand write. Importantly, once BRS GOLF have handed the customer [redacted-name] to V12 the club members credit application is handled by V12 and the club member directly. You don't have to get involved in any sale of the finance or the legal obligations that go with it. In fact, the application for finance is so integrated we strongly believe this will increase your member [redacted-name] through this quick and popular form of payment. REDUCED RISK OF LOST FEES. Once V12 have paid you, the member [redacted-name] is between the Golfer and V12. You won't have to worry about any recourse if something goes wrong or if the golfer [redacted-name] their payment to V12. In fact, it's only in exceptional circumstances that V12 may need the clubs help to resolve member [redacted-name]. QUICK SETTLEMENT! The V12 system will provide the golfer with a quick decision within seconds of them completing their details online. Once accepted, the golfer [redacted-name] their credit agreement, the member [redacted-name] is activated immediately and you will receive payment to your bank account within 4 working days from the golfer [redacted-name] agreement. It's as quick as that. HOW DO YOU PROMOTE MEMBER [redacted-name] TO THE GOLFER? BRS GOLF will help you with advertising Member [redacted-name] to all your members (including template emails for you to send, promotional banners within your members' booking website and suggested push notifications for your app users). All financial related terms and facts will be supplied by V12. The only rule, for regulatory reasons, is that you cannot use your own credit advertisement. This benefits you in knowing that any promotion of Member [redacted-name] will be legally compliant. WHAT CAN BE INCLUDED IN THE MEMBER [redacted-name] LOAN? At the moment only the golfers playing fees can be financed this means that green fees, locker fees, buggy hire, or any other playing fees, paid for up front and spread over the term of the golfers member [redacted-name]. In the future we are working with V12 to look at adding other golfer's requirements to the member [redacted-name] so that golfers will have even more affinity with the club. WHAT DOES IT COST? The Golfer [redacted-name] charged a small administration fee on top of their loan. For this product the club won't be charged any subsidy and you will receive the full member [redacted-name]. Member [redacted-name] can be offered on 4 or 10 month terms meaning there are extremely flexible options for you to offer Member [redacted-name] to full year or partial year memberships. HOW DO WE KNOW IF A MEMBER [redacted-name] FINANCE? Through your access to the V12 system, you will have a number of helpful tools to identify which member [redacted-name] successful in their loan application, the loan amount and when this was sent to your bank account. You will also be able to run simple reports which you can download for use in your own accounting system. DO WE HAVE TO BE AUTHORISED BY THE FINANCIAL CONDUCT AUTHORITY (FCA) If you are not authorised in your own right, you can offer the interest free finance loans only, however, the agreement with V12 is that they will consider appointing the club as an Introducer Appointed Representative (IAR). As an IAR you will need to comply with V12’s specific instructions and standards for how member [redacted-name] is promoted to your members. HOW LONG DOES IT TAKE TO SIGN-UP? You will be required to provide some information to V12 directly via an online form. V12 will need to approve your application and you should be ready to go within 10 working days of V12 receiving correctly completed documentation. Once approved you will be contacted by BRS Golf and V12 with your Member [redacted-name] access rights V12 Retail Finance Limited is registered in England and Wales [redacted-number]. Registered office: 20 Neptune Court, Vanguard Way, Cardiff, CF24 5PJ. Authorised by the Prudential Regulation Authority and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority and the Prudential Regulation Authority, Registration number: [redacted-number]. V12 Retail Finance Limited acts as a credit broker and only offers credit products from Secure Trust Bank PLC trading as V12 Retail Finance. Secure Trust Bank is registered in England and Wales [redacted-number]. Registered office: One Arleston Way, Solihull, B90 4LH. Authorised by the Prudential Regulation Authority and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority and the Prudential Regulation Authority. Registration number: [redacted-number]. Facilities Contacts Memberships Users Reports Search Tools Need Help? brs chatbot Sign Out System Tools Basic Set Up Requirements System Configuration Set up system parameters, eg. club address and email, and enable / disable certain features of the system. Configure Timesheet Set up Tee Times and Tee Time Intervals for individual days, months and years. Green Fee Rates Set up Green Fee Categories and Rates for Visitors, Societies, Member Guests, etc. Reservation Types Set up the Reservation Types and choose their colours. Booking Statuses Set up the Booking Statuses supported. Payment Methods Set up the Payment Methods supported. Contact Categories Set up the Contact Categories supported. Catering / Refreshments Set up Catering and Refreshments. No Show Reasons Set up reasons a player may not show for a booking. Services Set up Services offered by the club such as Buggies, Caddies, Club Hire, Room Hire, Trolleys and Course Set Up. Additional Set Up Requirements Copy Services, Catering or Green Fees Copy Services, Catering or Green Fees from one year to another year. Title for Each Day Set up a title for each day of the year which is displayed at the top of the timesheet pages. Messages on the Timesheet Set up messages that get displayed on the timesheet. Email and Letter Templates Set up a number of email and letter templates for sending to members and visitors, e.g. confirmation of booking, thank you message, etc. Upload Timesheet Upload a timesheet for any given day including the player names and membership number. Upload Members and Contacts Upload member and contact data files into the system. Membership Types Set up membership types such as full, 6-day, 5-day, senior, junior, honorary and country members. Legal Messages Set up Marketing Preferences, Privacy Policy, Member Terms and Conditions and Visitor Terms and Conditions. Course Restriction Restrict course bookings to limited group sizes. Messaging Email Messaging Send emails to your members and contacts. Text Messaging Send text messages to your members and contacts. Membership Groups for Messaging Set up membership groups and assign members to those groups. Club News Create club news articles which can be viewed by members and the public. Club Messages Send club messages to members who are using the BRS Members App or New Members Website. Members Booking Member Casual Booking Rules Set up the dates and times when members can view the timesheet and book casual golf on-line through the club website. Member Competitions Set up competitions for members to book on-line through the club website. Set this PC as Club House PC Set up / remove this PC as being Club House PC. This enables certain features within the club house. Visitor Booking Green Fee Rates for Visitors / Agents Set up green fee rates for visitors to book on-line through the club website. It is also for setting up rates for 3rd Party Tee Time Agents. Day Ticket Rates for Visitors Set up green fee rates for visitors playing 2 rounds on the same day to book on-line through the club website. Open Competitions for Visitors Set up open competitions for visitors to book on-line through the club website. Golf Events Set up part of the timesheet for the organiser of an event to populate. This can be used for a member event, a corporate day etc. Tour Operator Booking Green Fee Rates for Tour Operator Set up green fee rates for tour operators to book on-line through the club website. Competition Charging Process Competition Charges Process competition charges for each member. Club Website Update Club Website Update Fixture List, Club News and Competition Reports on the club website. It also allows you to collect and manage member and visitor feedback. Legal Messages Set up Marketing Preferences, Privacy Policy, Member Terms and Conditions and Visitor Terms and Conditions.
Course Restriction Restrict course bookings to limited group sizes.
Email Messaging Send emails to your members and contacts.
Text Messaging Send text messages to your members and contacts.
Membership Groups for Messaging Set up membership groups and assign members to those groups.
Club News Create club news articles which can be viewed by members and the public.
Club Messages Send club messages to members who are using the BRS Members App or New Members Website.
Member Casual Booking Rules Set up the dates and times when members can view the timesheet and book casual golf on-line through the club website.
Member Competitions Set up competitions for members to book on-line through the club website.
Set this PC as Club House PC Set up / remove this PC as being Club House PC. This enables certain features within the club house.
Green Fee Rates for Visitors / Agents Set up green fee rates for visitors to book on-line through the club website. It is also for setting up rates for 3rd Party Tee Time Agents.
Day Ticket Rates for Visitors Set up green fee rates for visitors playing 2 rounds on the same day to book on-line through the club website.
Open Competitions for Visitors Set up open competitions for visitors to book on-line through the club website.
Golf Events Set up part of the timesheet for the organiser of an event to populate. This can be used for a member event, a corporate day etc.
Green Fee Rates for Tour Operator Set up green fee rates for tour operators to book on-line through the club website.
Process Competition Charges Process competition charges for each member.
Update Club Website Update Fixture List, Club News and Competition Reports on the club website. It also allows you to collect and manage member and visitor feedback.
Booking Payment Requests View the status of your Booking Payment Requests.
General Payment Requests View the status of your General Payment Requests.
Setup Use this tool to set up BRS Payments.

Facilities Contacts Memberships Users Reports Search Tools Need Help? brs chatbot Sign Out System Tools Basic Set Up Requirements System Configuration Set up system parameters, eg. club address and email, and enable / disable certain features of the system. Configure Timesheet Set up Tee Times and Tee Time Intervals for individual days, months and years. Green Fee Rates Set up Green Fee Categories and Rates for Visitors, Societies, Member Guests, etc. Reservation Types Set up the Reservation Types and choose their colours. Booking Statuses Set up the Booking Statuses supported. Payment Methods Set up the Payment Methods supported. Contact Categories Set up the Contact Categories supported. Catering / Refreshments Set up Catering and Refreshments. No Show Reasons Set up reasons a player may not show for a booking. Services Set up Services offered by the club such as Buggies, Caddies, Club Hire, Room Hire, Trolleys and Course Set Up. Additional Set Up Requirements Copy Services, Catering or Green Fees Copy Services, Catering or Green Fees from one year to another year. Title for Each Day Set up a title for each day of the year which is displayed at the top of the timesheet pages. Messages on the Timesheet Set up messages that get displayed on the timesheet. Email and Letter Templates Set up a number of email and letter templates for sending to members and visitors, e.g. confirmation of booking, thank you message, etc. Upload Timesheet Upload a timesheet for any given day including the player names and membership number. Upload Members and Contacts Upload member and contact data files into the system. Membership Types Set up membership types such as full, 6-day, 5-day, senior, junior, honorary and country members. Legal Messages Set up Marketing Preferences, Privacy Policy, Member Terms and Conditions and Visitor Terms and Conditions. Course Restriction Restrict course bookings to limited group sizes. Messaging Email Messaging Send emails to your members and contacts. Text Messaging Send text messages to your members and contacts. Membership Groups for Messaging Set up membership groups and assign members to those groups. Club News Create club news articles which can be viewed by members and the public. Club Messages Send club messages to members who are using the BRS Members App or New Members Website. Members Booking Member Casual Booking Rules Set up the dates and times when members can view the timesheet and book casual golf on-line through the club website. Member Competitions Set up competitions for members to book on-line through the club website. Set this PC as Club House PC Set up / remove this PC as being Club House PC. This enables certain features within the club house. Visitor Booking Green Fee Rates for Visitors / Agents Set up green fee rates for visitors to book on-line through the club website. Day Ticket Rates for Visitors Set up green fee rates for visitors playing 2 rounds on the same day to book on-line through the club website. Open Competitions for Visitors Set up open competitions for visitors to book on-line through the club website. Golf Events Set up part of the timesheet for the organiser of an event to populate.
